symptom: The exported forwardVaultDigest hashes invalid records without calling validateForwardVaultRecord. Distinct non-JSON values such as NaN and null serialize to the same JSON, creating identical digests outside the append admission path.
lesson: Direct exported digest APIs must enforce the same record admission rules as append and persistence; canonical JSON serialization alone does not establish validity.
guardrail: Validate the complete Forward Vault record before hashing; throw TypeError for invalid records and regression-test non-finite/null serialization aliases without changing valid-record digest bytes.
